name: Elkan
description: A Balduvian mage who goads the orc general Jonar into battle intending the orcs to die.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jonar sends the goblins against the Kjeldorans first, then attacks, routing the knights; he kills Elkan when he intervenes.
timeline.quote: Jonar kills him and then lets the remaining knights leave without further harm

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "The Crucible of the Orcs , by Don Perrin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: killed him when he tried to intervene
relations.quote: When a furious Elkan tries to intervene, Jonar kills him
